tagline: Any HTML, printed as a receipt — one custom element, zero dependencies
description: One custom element that renders anything you wrap in it as a thermal receipt, then exports it as a PNG. Zero dependencies, no build step, MIT.

identity.concept: Tearline's own three strips, the drawing already in its nav — a sheet coming off the roll, each strip shorter than the last. What changes is that they are no longer three identical bars: the ramp puts them at 0.34, 0.62 and 1.0, so the last strip, the one that has torn free, is the fact the mark reports and the stagger reads as a tear rather than a stack. The live file nests them in an inner group, which the film's parser drops along with their fills; that nesting is folded into the one transform here.
identity.origin: The drawing already live in this product's own nav, carried across from Projects/tearline/public/logo.svg without touching its path data. Only the housing changed: the full-bleed accent tile became the estate family plate, the drawing was partitioned at its own subpath boundaries into the family's two-to-four shapes, and those shapes were put on the family opacity ramp.
identity.grammar: Estate family grammar, from src/components/product-mark.mjs on breachprobe: one #0a0a0a plate at rx 7, one colour (this product's accent), the 0.34 / 0.62 / 1.0 ramp, flat fills only, two to four shapes, nothing thinner than 3 units. Parsed by kynth-ops/video/build-film.mjs, which reads the shapes and the group transform straight out of this file.
identity.wordmark: none — the lockup is this glyph plus the product name as live text, never baked in

colors.note: Warm near-black ground, orange accent — measured off the live page today with getComputedStyle in headless Chrome (2026-08-15) at tearline.kynth.studio. Orange #ffa552 is the resolved value of this page's own background token, the computed background of the primary CTA (the tearline.js copy button), the computed colour of four links and the "Features" eyebrow, and the colour of fourteen accented hairlines. The ground #1a1917 is the resolved value of the page's black token, the computed body background and its theme-color meta. Ink #d1d1d1 is the computed colour of the h1; panels are computed on thirteen and eight sections. The receipt paper and ink are the page's own brand-paper and brand-ink tokens — they are the colours of the PRINTED ARTIFACT the product renders, not of the site, and are recorded here so nothing mistakes them for the ground. Two colours in the code sample, #82aaff and #c792ea, are syntax highlighting and are not brand values. Recorded as-is.
